items.title: Annual Maintenance Contracts
items.summary: Stop paying for surprise breakdowns. Planned maintenance for your control systems by experienced engineers, with guaranteed response times.
body: Unplanned downtime costs far more than prevention. Our contracts schedule inspections, firmware updates, backups and spare-part checks across your PLCs, drives and HMIs.
Each contract includes a named engineer, a response-time SLA and a quarterly health report.

items.title: Site Troubleshooting Services
items.summary: Control system misbehaving? Our field team diagnoses and fixes faults on site so production gets back on track fast.
body: We send certified engineers with diagnostic tooling for multi-vendor PLC, SCADA, drive and network faults.
Every visit ends with a root-cause report and recommendations to stop the fault coming back.

items.title: Industrial IIoT
items.summary: An IIoT platform that lets you watch your whole plant in real time — from performance and quality to equipment health.
body: Connect legacy and modern equipment through edge gateways and standard protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus).
Dashboards, alarms and analytics turn raw machine data into OEE, downtime and quality insights.

items.title: Industrial Automation
items.summary: Bespoke factory and process automation for machines and production lines — built for today and ready for tomorrow.
body: From control philosophy and panel design to PLC/HMI programming, commissioning and training.
We integrate new lines and modernise legacy control systems with minimal disruption.

items.title: Energy Management Systems (EMS)
items.summary: Measure, understand and cut energy use and cost with sustainable, standards-based EMS solutions.
body: Smart metering, power-quality monitoring and consumption analytics down to the machine level.

items.title: Smart Vision Systems
items.summary: Fully automated visual inspection for any product — faster, cheaper and more consistent quality control.
body: Camera, lighting and software selection tuned to your defect types and line speed.
Integrates with rejection mechanisms and your MES for full traceability.

items.title: Motion and Drives
items.summary: A complete line of motion products and precise drive solutions for demanding manufacturing.
body: Servo, stepper and VFD solutions sized and tuned to your mechanical load.
Multi-axis coordination and energy-efficient drive retrofits.

items.title: Pharmaceutical Auditing
items.summary: Audit trails, unique user accounts and e-signatures that support FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
body: We configure control systems with role-based access, secure audit trails and electronic records.
Validation documentation support for regulated manufacturing.

items.title: Robotics
items.summary: Reliable robotic cells with a sensible investment level and a calculated ROI.
body: Pick-and-place, palletising, welding and machine tending cells, including collaborative robots.
Simulation before build so you see cycle time and ROI up front.
